scope: Public hiring posts and indexed public profiles. Leads are researched snapshots; job feeds refresh automatically. Open the linked post to confirm the current opening and contact preference.

leads.location: Mountain View, CA; role-dependent remote options
leads.evidence: Official careers page says all experience levels are considered and describes new graduates on the team.
leads.verification: Company page verified; each requisition has its own requirements
leads.caution: Choose the closest actual opening and confirm its location and experience requirements. This is a company lead rather than a named recruiter's post.
leads.message: I am completing an MS in EE in December 2026 and can start in January 2027. My background includes a routed ASAP7 accelerator, PrimeTime timing/ECO work, a Python STA prototype, and a cocotb-based Verilog repair agent. I would be interested in early-career RTL, physical implementation, or CAD/EDA tooling work at MatX.

My work includes RTL-to-GDSII in Design Compiler/Innovus and PrimeTime MMMC timing/ECO analysis, with positive post-route setup and hold slack. Would your team consider a January new graduate, or is there an early-career requisition you recommend?
